title: New-Tire Visit Credit on Alignment Services & Plans Plan Visits
content:
A new-tire visit credit is taken off the labor charged on the open work order of an Alignment Services & Plans alignment plan when the vehicle carries a recently installed Crestline tire set. It is read from the vehicle's active tire set under Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty — its install date and whether its tire line includes a complimentary alignment check. The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the labor charged, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

| Vehicle's active Crestline tire set | Its tire line includes a complimentary alignment check | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Installed no more than 30 calendar days before the visit (the visit date itself included) | Yes | 15.00 |
| Installed no more than 30 calendar days before the visit | No | 10.00 |
| No active Crestline tire set installed within those 30 days | — | 0.00 |

The 30 days are the tire bundle window of every Alignment Services & Plans line, counted in calendar days from the tire set's install date to the visit date.

**Boundary pair (hypothetical):** a set installed 30 days before the visit qualifies; a set installed 31 days before does not.

**Floor (hypothetical):** a visit whose pricing base is 0.00 stays at 0.00 after the credit.
